title: Calculate Sensitivity — ebdt_se
text: Evaluating Binary Diagnostic Test (EBDT) function calculates sensitivity, standard error & Agresti-Coull CI - Apply continuity correction (Haldane–Anscombe) *pairs* zeros:    (s1,s0) /(r1,r0), avoiding adding 0.5 cells related    estimated proportion.   - Wilson, standard center half-width used:     center = (p + z^2/(2n)) / (1 + z^2/n)     half   = z/(1 + z^2/n) * sqrt(p(1-p)/n + z^2/(4n^2))   - Agresti-Coull:     n_tilde = n + z^2; p_tilde = (x + z^2/2)/n_tilde; half = z*sqrt(p_tilde(1-p_tilde)/n_tilde)
